      @NotNull public @NotNull FormField.ControlTypeEnum getControlType()
      The edit control used for this field in the edit form. This is not the data type of the attribute, although the control must be suitable for it (for example a number control for a numeric attribute). Whether a number must be a whole number follows from the attribute type.
